arms.A: trained representation, actual classes, main folds
arms.CAL_model: the published model's own decision 1[score > 0.5] on the calibration set (no probe)
arms.CAL_trained: trained representation, calibration labels, calibration folds
arms.CAL_twin: twin representation, calibration labels, calibration folds
arms.P_b: trained representation, permuted classes b = 0 .. B-1, main folds
arms.R: raw 64-bit model input as float64, actual classes, main folds (informational only)
arms.T: twin representation, actual classes, main folds
arms.score: balanced accuracy of the pooled held-out predictions (each example predicted exactly once)

claim_scope.accessibility_vs_information: every comparison is between balanced accuracies of one fixed linear probe; a higher score means the target is more linearly accessible from that representation under that probe, not that the representation holds more information. By the data-processing inequality I(T; h(X)) <= I(T; X) for every representation h of the 64-bit input X.
claim_scope.ce1_ce2_relation: uses the CE2 target construct and CE2's untrained twin; does not amend CE1 or CE2
not_claimed: that the network uses the target (A3 shows decodability without use)
a learned cryptanalytic strategy or an internal decision process
the exact fixed-key characteristic probability or the full-cipher differential probability
independence from CE2: the target is the CE2 construct
information-theoretic content: a deterministic representation of the input cannot contain more information about the target than the input does
anything about other checkpoints, layers, twins, probes, ciphers or round counts
absence of decodability after a non-rejection
claim_scope.positive_claim: linear-probe decodability of the coarsened CE2 target from the specified fixed representation under the specified probe

conduct.resume: the journal is authoritative; terminal states are never left; an artifact without a committed transition is quarantined and its step re-executed; a committed artifact that is missing or altered makes the replicate FAILED
conduct.smoke: non-evidentiary, separate autond_ce3_smoke_* directory, never merged

endpoints.C_task: BA(CAL_trained) - [0.5 + kappa * max(BA(CAL_model) - 0.5, 0)], kappa = 0.5: the probe must exceed a per-replicate recovery threshold set by the published model's own balanced accuracy on the same calibration examples (at the published reference accuracy 0.5144 the threshold is 0.5072)
endpoints.S1: R - (B + 2) / 2, where R in {1, ..., B + 1} is the rank of the observed assignment among the B + 1 group assignments when they are ordered by (exact rational BA, recorded tie-break value), ascending; S1 > 0 exactly when R is one of the upper (B + 1) / 2 ranks (R >= 4 for B = 5); S1 is never 0
endpoints.S1_margin: BA(A) - median_b BA(P_b): descriptive only, never tested
endpoints.kappa_rationale: kappa is the minimum fraction of the published model's own above-chance balanced accuracy that the probe must recover. The model's head is a sigmoid of a linear function of this same layer, so a linear probe can represent the model's decision exactly and kappa = 1 is attainable in the population; a finite-sample probe loses part of it (the pipeline-faithful power check measures the loss). kappa = 0.5 requires that at least half of the known signal survives the probe pipeline, so a pipeline that recovers only a small fraction of a known effect cannot pass, while estimation loss alone does not fail a working pipeline; the power evidence reports kappa in {0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9}. kappa is a prospective judgment, fixed before any CE3 measurement
endpoints.published_reference_source: autond_ce1/AutoND-upstream/README.md lines 151-181 at the pinned upstream commit: eval_nets.py on the polished round-8 SPECK32/64 checkpoint, 5 evaluation sets of 10^6 samples from main.make_train_data (label Y ~ Bernoulli(1/2), Y = 0 inputs uniform), metric accuracy of 1[score > 0.5] (eval_nets.py evaluate_X_Y), reported as mean 0.5144 +- 0.0003 (standard deviation over the 5 sets); the per-set TPR 0.512-0.514 and TNR 0.515-0.517 make the balanced accuracy equal to the accuracy to the reported precision
endpoints.raw_gap: BA(A) - BA(R): descriptive linear-accessibility contrast only

evidence_schema.calibration: runs/<id>/calibration.npz: genuine key_words, pt0, pt1, c0, c1, random_inputs_packed, order, labels
evidence_schema.data: runs/<id>/data.npz: CE2 run-data arrays (key_words, pt0, pt1, c0, c1, dx, dy, weights, target), classes (int8) and s1_tiebreak (int16, length B + 1)
evidence_schema.measurement: runs/<id>/measurement.json: balanced accuracies, endpoints, coverage, convergence, timings
evidence_schema.probes: runs/<id>/probes.npz: fold ids, permutation index vectors, and per arm and fold the scaler mean and scale, coefficients, intercepts, iterations, gradient norms and held-out predictions
evidence_schema.representations: runs/<id>/representations.npz: trained_main, twin_main, trained_cal, twin_cal (float32), score_main, score_cal (float32)

failure_semantics.EXCLUDED: a replicate with a non-finite endpoint
failure_semantics.FAILED: a replicate whose gate E/F, class coverage, twin admissibility, head consistency or probe convergence fails, or whose execution raises; retained with its partial artifacts
failure_semantics.VALID: all checks passed and all endpoints finite

representation.head_consistency: sigmoid(h @ W_dense_3 + b_dense_3) must equal model.predict(X) to within head_tolerance on every main and calibration example
representation.identity_rule: identity is the graph position and structure checked above; Keras layer names depend on how many models a process has built (the twin built second is named activation_5) and are recorded but never used for identity
representation.twin_admissibility: the twin representation must have at least 2 features with nonzero variance on every main and calibration set; otherwise the replicate is FAILED

untrained_twin.loading: targets/autond/model_binding.py load_untrained_twin with the weights hash
untrained_twin.scope: one fixed initialisation; results are conditional on it and say nothing about untrained DBitNets in general

source.use: read-only: the fixed untrained twin saved by this run is copied byte for byte into each CE3 output directory and hash-checked; no other CE2 evidence is used and CE2 is not amended

probe.convergence: a fit converges when n_iter_ < max_iter, no ConvergenceWarning is raised and the maximum absolute gradient of the training objective at the fitted parameters, computed independently of scikit-learn, is at most gradient_tolerance
probe.max_iter_rule: max_iter = 2000 unless the blinded benchmark records a non-converged fit at 2000 and every fit converges at 5000, in which case 5000; no other value and no retry
probe.non_convergence: the replicate is FAILED; nothing is retried or changed
probe.objective: mean multinomial (or binary) log-loss over the training fold plus ||W||^2 / (2 C n_train); the intercept is not penalised

references: Bellini et al., A Cipher-Agnostic Neural Training Pipeline with Automated Finding of Good Input Differences, IACR ePrint 2022/1467; https://github.com/Crypto-TII/AutoND
Hewitt and Liang, Designing and Interpreting Probes with Control Tasks, EMNLP 2019
Maurer, Hothorn and Lehmacher, Multiple comparisons in drug clinical trials and preclinical assays: a-priori ordered hypotheses, 1995
Berger, Multiparameter hypothesis testing and acceptance sampling, Technometrics 1982 (intersection-union)
Hemerik and Goeman, Exact testing with random permutations, TEST 2018 (permutation subgroups)
design.research_question: Across independent evaluation replicates, is the AutoND CE2 trajectory-derived target, coarsened into frozen whole-value classes, linearly decodable from the 64-unit penultimate ReLU representation of the published AutoND SPECK32/64 round-8 DBitNet, beyond a within-replicate permuted-label control and beyond one fixed untrained DBitNet, once the probe pipeline has shown that it recovers the known genuine-versus-random task?

sampling.calibration_construction: a separate set per replicate: 50000 fresh genuine pairs (CE2 generate_genuine_pairs) and 50000 uniform 64-bit inputs (CE2 random_pairs_input), labels 1 and 0, concatenated and shuffled by PCG64(30000000 + replicate_index).permutation
sampling.main_fold_assignment: sklearn KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=40000000 + replicate_index) applied to sample indices only, shared by every main-set arm
sampling.main_pairs_rule: the smallest n in {50000, 100000, 200000} whose uncertainty-propagated lower bound for P(SUPPORTED) (5th percentile over the bootstrap distribution of the synthetic pipeline parameters, evaluated with B = 21) is at least 0.90 at the reference scenario of the power evidence; if none qualifies the design is not frozen
sampling.pair_construction: fresh genuine pairs from os.urandom with the construction of upstream main.make_train_data (Y = 1): experiments/autond/ce2/adapter.py generate_genuine_pairs (pinned), gates E and F required
sampling.permutation_construction: a cyclic permutation group of order B + 1 per replicate: o = PCG64(50000000 + replicate_index).permutation(n) is cut, in order, into floor(n / (B + 1)) cycles of length B + 1 followed by cycles whose lengths divide B + 1 (largest divisor first) covering the remainder; sigma maps each element of a cycle to the next one (sigma[c] = roll(c, -1)); permuted arm b = 0 .. B-1 uses labels[sigma^(b+1)], where sigma^(B+1) is the identity, so {id, sigma, ..., sigma^B} is a group and the observed assignment is its identity element; global class counts are preserved exactly
sampling.permutations_rule: B odd, so that B + 1 assignments split into two equal halves of ranks; the smallest B in {5, 11, 21} whose planning P(SUPPORTED) at the reference scenario is within 0.01 of B = 21 and whose uncertainty-propagated lower bound still meets the n rule
sampling.s1_tiebreak: per replicate, a uniformly random permutation (t_0, ..., t_B) of {0, ..., B} drawn with random.SystemRandom (os.urandom) when the data are generated and committed in data.npz as s1_tiebreak before any probe is fitted; t_0 belongs to the observed assignment and t_(b+1) to permuted arm b

seeds.data: os.urandom; the generated data are retained, not their seeds
seeds.s1_tiebreak: os.urandom via random.SystemRandom; recorded in data.npz, not derived from a seed

decision.INCONCLUSIVE: fewer than 20 VALID replicates, an untestable step, or S1 not rejected
decision.POSITIVE_CONTROL_FAILED: C not rejected; S1 and S2 are reported descriptively as not tested
decision.PRECHECK_FAILED: preflight, binding, provenance, pins, P1 or benchmark check failed
decision.SUPPORTED: C, S1 and S2 rejected in the frozen order
decision.TARGET_DECODABLE_TWIN_UNRESOLVED: C and S1 rejected, S2 not

statistics.descriptive: mean, median with exact order-statistic 95% interval, quartiles, range and all values
statistics.estimand: q(D) = P(D_i > 0) for a valid replicate i, separately for each endpoint
statistics.gate_C: H0_C = H0_task OR H0_twin, with H0_task: q(C_task) <= 1/2 and H0_twin: q(C_twin) <= 1/2; C is rejected only when both component tests reject at alpha (Berger's intersection-union test: under H0_C at least one component null is true, and that component rejects with probability at most alpha, so the gate has level alpha without adjustment)
statistics.interval: two-sided exact 95% Clopper-Pearson interval for q over all valid replicates
statistics.multiplicity: fixed-sequence gatekeeping at full alpha: a step is tested only after every earlier step rejected; the family-wise error rate is at most alpha under arbitrary dependence
statistics.no_valid_observations: n = 0: no p-value, not rejected, reported NO_VALID_OBSERVATIONS
statistics.non_finite: a non-finite endpoint makes the replicate EXCLUDED; it is never treated as zero
statistics.s1_null: H0_S1: conditional on the trained representation matrix H, the label-independent folds F and the class-count vector N = (N_0, ..., N_4) of the replicate's main-set labels, the label vector y is exchangeable: every arrangement of labels with counts N is equally likely, whatever H is. It holds in particular when the rows (h_j, y_j) are i.i.d. with y_j independent of h_j
statistics.s1_null_exactness: every element of the permutation group G = {id, sigma, ..., sigma^B} preserves N, and under H0_S1 y o sigma has the same conditional law as y given (H, F, N). Replacing y by y o sigma maps the assignment tuple (y, y o sigma, ..., y o sigma^B) to its cyclic shift, so, conditionally on (H, F, N), the score tuple s_j = f(H, y o sigma^j, F) of the deterministic probe has the same law as its cyclic shift, whatever ties the discrete balanced accuracy produces. The recorded tie-break is a uniform permutation independent of (H, F, N, y), so the pairs (s_j, t_j) are distinct and jointly shift-invariant in law; all B + 1 positions therefore have the same rank law, and since the ranks are a permutation of 1 .. B + 1, P(R = r | H, F, N) = 1/(B + 1) for each r and P(S1 > 0 | H, F, N) = 1/2 exactly; the unconditional statement follows by averaging. The event E that coverage and convergence hold for all B + 1 assignments is a function of (H, F) and of the set of assignments, hence shift-symmetric, so the law also holds given E. Other validity checks (for example the T arm, which uses y) need not be symmetric, but {S1 rejects and all replicates VALID} is contained in {S1 rejects and E holds in every replicate}, so P(S1 rejects and all VALID) <= P(S1 rejects | E) <= alpha. Replicates are independent, so N+ ~ Bin(n, 1/2) under H0_S1 given E
statistics.s1_superseded_rule: the earlier rule S1 = BA(A) - median of B permuted BAs with zeros removed is not exact: with exchangeable two-valued scores P(s = 1) = 0.3 and B = 5 it gives P(S1 > 0 | S1 != 0) = 0.687 (and 0.313 for P(s = 1) = 0.7), so it was replaced
statistics.test: exact one-sided binomial test over all n valid replicates: N+ = #{i : D_i > 0}, p = P(X >= N+), X ~ Bin(n, 1/2); reject when p < alpha (with n = 20: N+ >= 15); valid for every q <= 1/2 because P(Bin(n, q) >= k) is increasing in q
statistics.unit: the replicate; folds and permutations are nested within it
statistics.zero_policy: an endpoint exactly 0.0 (including -0.0) is a non-positive outcome: it stays in the denominator and counts against rejection; no zero is ever removed. S1 cannot be 0

target.class_rule: class(T) = number of frozen edges e with T > e; equal T values are never split
target.coverage_checked_for: the actual target labels and every permuted label vector on the main folds, and the calibration labels on the calibration folds, in every training and test partition
target.fallback_resolution: resolved before production by P1: the class count and edges are frozen in this design and applied unchanged to every replicate; no replicate is rebinned and no three-class branch exists in the confirmatory protocol; a replicate violating the class-coverage minimum is FAILED

pilot.exploratory_pilot_disclosed: an earlier unrecorded in-memory pilot of 10^6 pairs (P0) showed 57 integer values in [-91, -35]; it was used only to judge that five classes are feasible and is not evidence
pilot.name: P1
pilot.rule: among all whole-value partitions of the P1 support into K classes whose every class holds at least min_class_fraction of P1, choose the one minimising sum_j |K * N(T <= e_j) - j * N|, ties broken by the lexicographically smallest edge tuple; K = 5, and K = 3 only if no five-class partition is feasible

target.source: T = sum over the 8 rounds of log2 xdp+ along the reconstructed genuine-pair trajectory, computed by experiments/autond/ce2/adapter.py trajectory_and_weights (r3, pinned)

verification.independence: imports nothing from the CE3 producer modules, targets/autond or core.evidence; it has its own journal replay, KFold, permutation-group and tie-break reconstruction, class assignment, edge selection, scaler, logistic-objective gradient, prediction, float and exact rational balanced accuracy, S1 rank, exact sign tests, Clopper-Pearson bisection and decision rule
verification.numerical_policy: representations are re-extracted and compared bitwise; if they differ, the stored probe parameters are applied to the re-extracted representations and every held-out prediction, endpoint sign and the decision must be identical (DECISION_INVARIANT_NUMERICAL_DIFFERENCE); any sign or decision difference fails

shared_with_producer.ce2_verifier_primitives: experiments/autond/ce2/verify.py (pinned): SPECK trajectory (_trajectory, _ror), xdp+ weights (xdp_weight), word-to-bit conversion (_words_to_bits), sha256_file, canonical_sha256, content_hash, Findings, load_upstream, strict_matches_hdf5 and weights_hash; the CE3 producer uses CE2 r3 adapter.py, which the CE2 verifier was written to check independently, so these primitives are independent of the producer's cipher but are themselves CE2 code
shared_with_producer.evidence_infrastructure: the verifier does not import core/evidence.py but reads the core-journal-2 journal, record caches, quarantine and staging layout that it writes, and the content-hash convention shared with CE2
shared_with_producer.inference: TensorFlow/Keras 2.15 predict for both representations and the model scores
shared_with_producer.model_building_and_binding: the pinned upstream dbitnet.make_model builder loaded through CE2 load_upstream; the producer loads the same builder through targets/autond/upstream.py and binds with targets/autond/model_binding.py, the verifier binds with the CE2 verifier's strict_matches_hdf5 and weights_hash
